description: Create an X lead form — the native form an X lead ad opens, so people sign up without leaving X. The X lead ad chain: lead form -> create_x_ads_card(leadFormId) -> create_x_ads_post(cardUri, lineItemId) on a WEBSITE_CLICKS line item (X retired the LEAD_GENERATION objective) -> get_x_ads_leads. Needs name, purpose, fields (at least one required), and an https privacy policy URL + company name. X ties every form to a conversion event: an ad account with no X Pixel needs conversionEventId, and the refusal says so plainly. X also builds a customer-list audience of the form's leads. Read back from X. Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

companyName.description: company name shown on the form

conversionEventId.description: Event ID from X Events Manager — required when the ad account has no X Pixel

fields.description: at least one must not be optional

key.description: lead field the form collects, from X's fixed list of lead field keys

optional.description: true = the person may skip this field; at least one field must not be optional

name.description: internal name of the lead form

purpose.description: what the leads are used for (shown to the person)

thankYouButton.description: label of the thank-you page button

thankYouDescription.description: text on the thank-you page shown after submit

thankYouHeadline.description: headline on the thank-you page shown after submit

thankYouUrl.description: https link on the thank-you button

name: create_x_ads_lead_form
title: Create an X lead form
